plugin.description: One capability per Firefly Services API operation, generated from Adobe's OpenAPI specs: Firefly image generation, expand, fill, composites, upscaling and video, and Photoshop document edits, actions, UXP scripts, artboards and layer manifests. The config object holds OAuth server-to-server credentials (client id and secret as secret references). Async jobs are polled inside the step, which returns the job result. Request fields are top-level parameters; an optional body carries the rest of the JSON document. Files move by URL: pass presigned storage URLs as sources and output destinations.
plugin.summary: Adobe Firefly Services: Firefly image and video generation and Photoshop document edits.
